title: Fully faithful pullback of descent data along an fpqc singleton covering
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $a:X\to S$ be a morphism, and let the singleton family $\{r:X'\to X\}$ be an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], and regard $X'$ as a scheme over $S$ via $a\circ r$. Pullback along $r$ induces a functor $DD(X/S)\to DD(X'/S)$ from descent data for $X/S$ to descent data for $X'/S$ [def-pd-descent-datum]. This functor is fully faithful. Here $DD(X/S)$ denotes the category whose objects are the descent data $(V,\varphi)$ on schemes $V$ over $X$ relative to $X/S$ [def-pd-descent-datum] and whose morphisms $(V,\varphi)\to(W,\psi)$ are the morphisms $\alpha:V\to W$ over $X$ with $\psi\circ\mathrm{pr}_0^*\alpha=\mathrm{pr}_1^*\alpha\circ\varphi$; for a morphism $r:T\to X$ over $S$ (with $T\to S$ the given structure map), the pullback of $(V,\varphi)$ along $r$ is $(T\times_XV,(r\times r)^*\varphi)$ [def-pc-fibre-product], where $r\times r:T\times_ST\to X\times_SX$, and the pullback of $\alpha$ is $\mathrm{id}_T\times_X\alpha$.
